datasets.access_notes: Public data card; downloading through the website or Kaggle API normally requires a Kaggle account and acceptance of Kaggle terms.

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
licence.redistribution: Redistribution is permitted with attribution, but the raw dataset is intentionally not included in this repository.

datasets.subset_used: All 4,094 image-audio pairs listed by the local dataset.csv were indexed; the formal test partition contains 596 paired events.
datasets.expected_layout: dataset.csv plus image/positive, image/negative, audio/positive, and audio/negative directories
datasets.notes: Paired proxy data used for cross-modal split alignment and decision fusion. Airborne audio is not laboratory acoustic emission.

datasets.access_notes: Public Mendeley Data download; no account was required when the source metadata was verified.

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
licence.redistribution: Redistribution is permitted with attribution, but the images are not duplicated in this source submission.

datasets.subset_used: All 40,000 images (20,000 Positive and 20,000 Negative) were considered before cross-dataset exact and perceptual deduplication.
datasets.expected_layout: Positive and Negative directories containing 227 x 227 RGB JPEG images
datasets.notes: Clean binary crack images generated as patches from 458 high-resolution source images.

datasets.access_notes: Download CODEBRIM_classification_dataset.zip from Zenodo. No account is normally required, but use is conditional on the accompanying custom licence.

licence.name: CODEBRIM custom non-commercial research and education licence
licence.redistribution: The database and modified versions must not be redistributed. Derived annotations or trained models that do not directly contain the data may be shared for non-commercial research and education under the stated terms.

datasets.subset_used: Only the unbalanced classification dataset was used. Of 7,729 physical images joined to annotations, 7,677 were retained after excluding 52 all-zero annotation records.
datasets.notes: The official train/validation/test assignment was retained, and crops from one parent image remain in one split. Labels denote visible defect types, not structural severity.

datasets.access_notes: Public direct download from Utah State University; no account was required when the source metadata was verified.

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
licence.redistribution: Redistribution is permitted with attribution; this repository supplies manifests rather than the image archive.

datasets.subset_used: Deck, pavement, and wall subsets were scanned. The frozen grouped manifest retains 56,088 images after excluding four files involved in conflicting exact-hash labels.
datasets.expected_layout: Decks, Pavements, and Walls directories, each with Cracked and Non-cracked subdirectories
datasets.notes: Parent patches from the same original surface image are grouped before the 70/15/15 split.

datasets.access_notes: Public Harvard Dataverse dataset. Download only the required measurement campaign/sensor files to avoid acquiring the complete multi-gigabyte collection.

licence.name: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal
licence.redistribution: The source data are released under CC0, but this repository contains only the derived split manifest.

datasets.subset_used: A 69-file F50A sensor subset from one measurement sequence was indexed. The binary proxy uses 50 files: 5/10 cNm as class 0 and 40/50/60 cNm as class 1; 20/30 cNm records are excluded from the binary task.
datasets.notes: A controlled bolted-joint acoustic-emission proxy, not physical MPU6050 building-vibration validation.
